supersedes.reason: Independent security review found the raw capability token retained in framework middleware metadata. This replacement binds the canonical package rebuilt after digest-only retained configuration and mutable startup-record clearing.

checks.result: All 12 service tests passed. Direct assertions prove the raw bearer is absent from Starlette registration metadata and the constructed middleware stack before, during, and after lifespan; only the SHA-256 digest is retained. Valid and invalid mutable startup records are cleared in place.

checks.command: cargo clippy/test plus three consecutive supervision_check runs against the rebuilt package
checks.result: Six native tests and three complete real-package lifecycle reports passed. The supervisor snapshots every concrete Job process handle before termination and waits for all captured root/descendant handles, eliminating the timing-sensitive return during kernel teardown.
